item.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine awaits White House sign-off on US drone production deal
item.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says he is awaiting White House approval for a major drone production agreement proposed by Kyiv last year

item.title: Russian court convicts 19 people over deadly 2024 Moscow concert hall attack
item.summary: A Moscow court has convicted 19 people of involvement in the 2024 shootings that killed 149 and injured more than 600 at a concert hall in Moscow

item.title: China positions itself as force for global stability at its annual Congress
item.summary: China is signaling it will stay focused on technology and economic growth, even as U.S. tensions with Iran rise

item.title: Iraq says at least one killed in Basra port attack as country halts operations at oil ports
item.summary: Iraq says at least one killed in Basra port attack as country halts operations at oil ports

item.title: Germany, Austria to release oil from reserves in response to 400M barrel request
item.summary: Germany and Austria say they will release parts of their oil reserves following an International Energy Agency request for members to release a record 400 million barrels to help calm energy price spikes due to the Iran war

item.title: Drone strike hits school and medical center in Sudan, killing 17, mostly schoolgirls
item.summary: An explosive-laden drone blamed on Sudanese paramilitaries has struck a secondary school and a health care center in southern Sudan, killing at least 17 people, mostly schoolgirls, a hospital official and a medical group said

item.title: Hungary to declassify security report as PM claims Ukraine illegally funding opponent
item.summary: Hungary’s government says it is declassifying a national security report that Prime Minister Viktor Orbán claims shows his top rival takes illegal money from Ukraine

item.title: At least 50 people killed and 125 others reported missing after Ethiopia landslides
item.summary: An official says at least 50 people have died and 125 others are missing after landslides hit three districts in southern Ethiopia following a week of heavy rains

item.title: Senegal is the latest African country to toughen punishment for homosexual acts
item.summary: Senegal’s parliament has approved a bill that toughens punishment for homosexuality in the largely conservative West African nation
